protocol.question: Does a network with maximum gains fixed from t=0 achieve the previously observed noisy transmission without gain learning?

conditions.fixed_all: All three gains=4 and b=0.08 fixed from t=0; no parameter learning in training or tests. Primary unlearned baseline.
conditions.fixed_gain: All three gains=4 fixed from t=0, b=0.08 initially with its original local update; test b adaptive and frozen copies. Secondary decomposition.
conditions.normal_reference: Previously completed normal noisy training, exact learned checkpoint and matched test field reused, not counted as new independent seeds.
conditions.ungated_reference: Previously completed ungated noisy training, frozen learned checkpoint comparator.
conditions.fixed_all_max_b: Secondary fully nonlearning comparator: gains=4 and b=1.1 (the original upper bound) from t=0, fixed throughout. Tests whether nominal b handicaps the unlearned comparator at shorter intervals. No tuning from data.

protocol.primary_test: 128 held-out irregular impulses at original base gap20 (20..24), all12 lanes at layer130. Primary fixed_all baseline versus previous normal frozen; fixed_all_max_b is declared secondary. 24 impulses secondary.
protocol.secondary_fast_test: Same counts with base gap8 (8..9.6), declared before baseline results to check rate dependence; held-out random stage count+1000, distinct from training and primary tests. Re-test normal and ungated learned checkpoints under this identical faster field.
protocol.noise_field: Same SplitMix64/Box-Muller fields as previous campaign; labels and occurrences matched across conditions, stage0 training, count primary test, count+1000 fast test.
protocol.statistics: Seed unit only; paired bootstrap 20000 percentile resamples; exact two-sided sign tests. Holm across3 primary normal-frozen minus fixed-all recall comparisons. Other analyses exploratory.
protocol.no_selection: No seed excluded; fixed 2048 training pulses, no outcome-dependent extension, no gain or b tuning on held-out data.
protocol.fixed_b_note: b=0.08 is the original nominal initial value, not selected from results. No optimality claim versus every possible fixed-gain/fixed-b design.
protocol.data_policy: Original results retained; new output files, no replacement of earlier deliverables.
